guidebook.intro: Hadithi za Kiingereza huanza na **Once upon a time** na huendelea kwa **and then… and then…**

phrases.target: That’s the end of the story.

tips.title: Once upon a time
body: **Hapo zamani za kale** ni **Once upon a time**. **Palikuwa na** ni **there was**: **Once upon a time, there was a hare.**
Mwisho wa hadithi nyingi za watoto: **…and they lived happily ever after.** (…wakaishi kwa furaha milele.)

tips.title: And then: wakati uliopita
body: Kiingereza hakina **-ka-**. Kila tukio hukaa katika wakati uliopita, likiunganishwa na **and**, **then** au **and then**: **The hare went to the river, and then he met a crocodile.**
Maneno ya kusimulia: **one day** (siku moja), **suddenly** (ghafla), **in the end** (mwishowe).

culture.title: Hadithi za Kiingereza
body: Hadithi maarufu za Kiingereza ni **fairy tales** na **fables**, kama **The Tortoise and the Hare** (Kobe na Sungura), ambamo kobe mwepesi wa polepole anashinda.

stories.title: Sungura na mamba
stories.summary: Bibi anamsimulia Neema jinsi sungura mjanja alivyomdanganya mamba.

line.speaker: bibi
line.target: Once upon a time, there was a clever hare.
line.base: Hapo zamani za kale, palikuwa na sungura mjanja.

line.speaker: bibi
line.target: One day, the hare wanted to cross the river, but he saw a crocodile.
line.base: Siku moja, sungura akataka kuvuka mto, lakini akaona mamba.

line.speaker: bibi
line.target: The hare said, “The king wants to count all the crocodiles!”
line.base: Sungura akasema, “Mfalme anataka kuhesabu mamba wote!”

line.speaker: bibi
line.target: The crocodiles lined up, and the hare jumped across their backs to the other side.
line.base: Mamba wakapanga mstari, na sungura akaruka juu yao mpaka ng’ambo.
